patch_description: Replace the fixed exponential moving average with a causal, robust local-linear estimator followed by an adaptive alpha-beta tracking stage. The local regression evaluates the trend at the newest sample, avoiding the window-centering lag of a moving average. Huber reweighting suppresses impulsive samples, while the innovation-dependent gain increases during real directional movement and decreases during stationary noisy periods. A small slope dead-band prevents noise-scale sign changes from becoming false reversals without freezing meaningful trends. The output contract remains unchanged: one filtered value per complete window, aligned to each window's newest sample.
